_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v5: vc-frontend 2.51.1 built from source. Barlow typeface (BekaertText is proprietary, not redistributable); preset default/assets/presets/bekaert.json (primary #01ADEF, accent #FF602C); pill buttons; light utility bar and light footer panel; hero copy overlaid left with a CTA; category card carousel with arrows below; fullscreen catalog dropdown; footer links grouped into columns from the flat CMS menu list via a 'Column | Link' title convention.
